name: pi-pstack
description: Local Pi twin of Cursor pstack v0.15.2 (max practical parity; see PARITY.md behavioral scorecard).
author: Lauren Tan (original pstack); Pi port contributors (@just-joshn)

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && node compat/check.mjs && node spec/spec-check.mjs && node tests/runner.mjs
scripts.compat:gate: node compat/check.mjs && node compat/report.mjs --check && node spec/spec-check.mjs --require-complete && npm run test:differential && npm test && npm run parity:check
scripts.spec:gate: node spec/spec-check.mjs --require-complete && npm test && npm run parity:check && npm run test:differential && npm run test:acceptance && npm run test:coverage
scripts.parity:check: node port/port.mjs check && node port/contract.mjs && node port/alias.mjs
scripts.test:extensions: node --experimental-strip-types --import ./extensions/test/peer-deps.mjs extensions/test/sticky-input-source.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --import ./extensions/test/peer-deps.mjs extensions/test/spawn-orch-p1-unit.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --import ./extensions/test/peer-deps.mjs extensions/test/spawn-orch-p1b-unit.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --import ./extensions/test/peer-deps.mjs extensions/test/verify-local-partials.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types extensions/test/skill-commands.mjs
